body_lead: Bengaluru: Vehicle users on guard against AI-based cameras installed by traffic police to track and nail vehicles breaking rules in Bengaluru city will soon have to be on alert against similar devices that the transport department has decided to deploy on roads. The department's AI-based cameras will be keeping a hawk's eye at 20 spots on the outskirts of Bengaluru city and Mysuru, Kolar, Tumakuru and Ramanagara districts. This marks the first such initiative by the department.
